prompts.prompt: Build a shipping method selector card with three options: Standard (free, 5-7 days), Express ($9.99, 2-3 days), and Overnight ($19.99, next day) using radio selection.
Create a user profile editing modal dialog with avatar upload preview, display name input, email address input, and Save/Cancel buttons.
Build a 3-step checkout wizard with a top progress stepper (Cart -> Shipping -> Payment), step action buttons, and order summary card.
Render a server status banner callout with an amber warning tone, displaying 'Maintenance scheduled for 02:00 UTC', an action link, and a dismiss icon button.
Create an analytics KPI grid displaying three stat cards: Monthly Revenue ($48,200, +12%), Active Users (3,420, +5%), and Conversion Rate (4.2%, -0.8%).
Build a SaaS settings panel layout with a left sidebar navigation rail, a top bar header with search spotlight trigger, and a main content area containing a security configuration card.
Create a search filter bar with a text input field, a category dropdown select, an in-stock toggle switch, and a Reset filters button.
Create a skeleton loading card grid showing 3 animated placeholder cards with avatar circles and text line skeletons.
Build a customer data table with sortable columns (Name, Role, Status, Last Active), row selection checkboxes, pagination controls, and status badges.
Build a responsive product pricing table with 3 plans (Starter $0, Pro $29/mo, Enterprise Custom), highlighting the Pro plan with an accent badge and CTA button.
Create a context menu popup triggered on right-click over a data row offering Edit, Duplicate, Share, and Delete options.
Build an AI chat window with a sidebar conversation list, message bubbles (user vs assistant), typing indicator spinner, and an auto-expanding text area input with send button.
Create a file upload drag-and-drop zone card displaying upload progress bar (72%), file name, file size, and cancel upload icon button.
Create an interactive notification popover menu with unread count badge, list of 3 recent alert items with timestamps, and a 'Mark all as read' button.
Build a confirmation alert dialog for deleting an API key, featuring a danger tone title, warning message text, and 'Cancel' / 'Delete Key' buttons.
Mount a ThemeProvider with dark mode enabled, grass accent color, and large panel radius, rendering a sample dashboard preview card.
Build a key-value data list showing user account metadata: Account ID, Created Date, Billing Cycle, and Subscription Tier.
Build a tabbed interface containing three tab panels (General, Notifications, Security) with active indicator highlighting and smooth content switching.
Create a color picker popover control displaying a preset color swatch grid, hex text input field, and reset button.
Build a team member invite modal form with email input list, role selector dropdown (Admin, Member, Viewer), custom permission toggles, and Send Invites CTA button.
